title: Aria object and enemy sprites, boxes and stats
limitations: Only objects and enemies whose create routine is traced (wooden door, bat, zombie with its puddle and drip frames, blue crow, zombie soldier with its grenade and gib frames, axe armor with its walker probe table, skull archer with its volley table and arrow frame, needles with its piece frames, the Medusa head in both palettes, the zombie officer with its gib frames, the gargoyle, the Ghost Dancer in three palettes, Curly), plus the crow's feather frame and the shared effects of the common sheet 0x081C15F4 and frames 0x0820ED60: the death flame (animation 0, OBJ row 7 = bank 3 of 0x082099FC) the blood splash (animation 13, OBJ row 8 = bank 4) the smoke particles (animation 5, rows 6 and 5 = banks 2 and 1) and the drifting fire, spark, dust and impact of sub_08045CEC (animations 1, 16, 4 and 7) and the shell casing (frame 0x35).

title: Aria runtime rooms (background, BG1 collision, transitions, entities)
limitations: 342 of 343 rooms export; one has no decodable BG1 collision table. The background is a static composite.

title: Soma animation library
limitations: One-shot animations use their own palette bank instead of the previous one.

title: Soma weapon records and blade sprites
limitations: All 59 weapon records and their sprites are exported; class 1 blades rotate about the entity position (the affine double-size placement is not modelled) and the class 4 casing and impact come from the object library.

title: Music and sound effects
limitations: Zero Mission only: its sound bank and engine tables are exported privately; the music and the sound effects of the ported systems (Samus, weapons, hatches, blocks, enemies, drops) play through the ported engine, with the item jingles inserted in front of the music and the current track replayed after them, and the Chozo hint music; the audio device pulls the sound frame by frame at the hardware's 65.536 kHz rate (resampled by SDL), so game slowdowns cannot starve it; not yet compared with hardware. Liquids, ground effects, charge beams, bombs and bosses have no sounds yet. Aria of Sorrow audio is not started.

title: Zero Mission enemy sprites, effects, room placements and sprite tables
limitations: Only sprites with a ported AI are exported (Zoomers, Zeelas, Rippers, Skrees and their explosion parts, red Zeela eyes, Wavers, Sidehoppers, Dessgeegas including the Long Beam one, Violas, Sovas, Zebs, Geegas, Zebbos, Reos, Mellas, Holtzes, Multiviolas, Rinkas, Gerutas, Ripper IIs, Squeepts, Gamets, Skulteras, Dragons, the elevator pads, water drops, steam vents, Gerons, unknown item blocks, map stations, save platforms (with their row 2 flash), Space Pirates and their lasers, searchlights, security lasers and searchlight eyes), plus the enemy drops, the ported particle effects and sprite debris, and the message banner with the save prompt's cursor; hard-mode and event spritesets are not resolved; the baked frozen and stun variants take frozenPaletteRowOffset as 0.
